_comment: Roster membership, decided by positioning — see CANDIDATES.md, whose tables are generated from this file. Membership is per-platform and capped at the size of the segment on that platform; shipping on a platform does not earn a slot there.

_legend.✓?: claimed but unverified — not measured until confirmed
_legend.degraded: member, but the product is degraded on this platform
_legend.n/a: the product does not exist on this platform — a fact about it, not a gap here
_legend.surplus: ships on this platform but sits outside its roster, which is already full
_legend.notes: optional per-platform override of `note`, keyed by platform

notes.linux: degraded, per their own documentation — the rendered cursor is lost, so S3 is n/a here

notes.windows: closed source, widest feature coverage — also on the Microsoft Store
cross-platform, verified at source — holds the fifth slot
notes.macos: would be sixth; the table is full
notes.linux: ships an AppImage; the Linux table is not capped, so this is a decision, not a limit

tools.note: closed source, Rust/wgpu — Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian, Arch, GNOME
